name: FUN_DOCIO_STREAMS
description: This table contains details of streams, which refer to the continuous flow of business documents exchanged between systems or parties across various channels. These streams facilitate seamless, real-time document processing. This table serves as a  persistent table that holds the details of the channel  through which the input and output of the document receives or sends documents.

columns.name: STREAM_CODE
columns.description: Stream code for the Document IO stream.

columns.name: STREAM_DIRECTION_CODE
columns.description: Identifies stream direction code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_STREAM_DIRS.

columns.name: STREAM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies strea types. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_STREAM_TYPES.

columns.name: STREAM_STORE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies credential store type code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_CRED_STORES.

columns.name: STREAM_STORE_CONFIG
columns.description: Stream store configurations for the Document IO stream.

columns.name: CREDENTIAL_STORE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies credential store type code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_CRED_STORES.

columns.name: CREDENTIAL_CONFIG
columns.description: Credential configurations for the Document IO stream.

columns.name: STREAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Stream email for the Document IO stream.

columns.name: STREAM_ENDPOINT
columns.description: Stream endpoint for the Document IO stream.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
